purpose: The 1px line a ButtonGroup draws between two segments, painted to match the group's Variant. It is never placed by hand.

notFor.case: Separating sections of a page, list or menu.

Default.visual: A 1px line: Action/primary/pressed (default), Border/subtle (secondary), Border/inverse (inverse) or Border/control (outline).

notes: Decorative: the segments carry all meaning.

openQuestions: Contrast: the divider is decorative. Does it need to meet a non-text contrast floor against the segment fills, or is it exempt?
